lessons.title: Planning a Toy Report
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to plan a short non-fiction report about a toy using headings.
success_criteria: I can choose a toy to write about.
I can plan 2 headings for my report.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap non-fiction reading from Week 5.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model planning a simple report with headings (e.g. 'What is it made of?', 'Who invented it?').
lessons.independent_task: Children plan their own toy report using a template with 2-3 headings.
key_questions: What will you write under each?

differentiation.support: Adult provides headings to choose from

lessons.assessment_notes: Note planning skill for non-fiction writing — evidence for ENG.W2.
lessons.plenary: Share report plans with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Think about what else you'd like to include in your report.

lessons.title: Half-Term Number Recap: Counting and Place Value
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate counting and place value skills built this half-term.
success_criteria: I can count to 20 and beyond.
I can represent numbers using tens and ones.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key number learning this half-term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap covering counting, ordering, and tens/ones.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed number recap worksheet/activity.
lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term number assessment for each child — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.home_link: Practise your favourite number activity from this half-term.

lessons.title: Half-Term Recap: Toys Then and Now
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall key facts from the whole toys topic.
success_criteria: I can recall a fact about toys in the past.
I can recall a fact about toys today.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole toys topic using the class timeline and displays.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quiz-style recap of the whole topic.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a topic recap quiz/worksheet.
key_questions: What have you learned this topic?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final topic assessment for HIST.1 across the toys topic.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family everything you remember about the toys topic.

lessons.title: Finishing Touches to Museum Displays
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to add finishing touches to their toy museum artwork.
success_criteria: I can improve one piece of my artwork.
I can explain my improvement.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art created this topic.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss the idea of refining and improving artwork.
lessons.independent_task: Children choose one piece of art from the topic to refine/finish.
key_questions: Why does this make it better?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective improvement skill — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Improve a piece of art or work at home.

lessons.title: Writing My Toy Report
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a short non-fiction report using their plan.
success_criteria: I can write under my headings.
I can check my sentences make sense.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap Monday's report plan.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing under a heading using the plan.
lessons.independent_task: Children write their toy report using their plan from Monday.
key_questions: What are you writing under this heading?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write independently with varied sentence structures

lessons.assessment_notes: Note non-fiction writing progress — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Read your report to your family.

lessons.title: Half-Term Recap: Addition and Subtraction
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate addition and subtraction skills built this half-term.
success_criteria: I can add within 20.
I can subtract within 20.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies used this half-term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap covering addition, subtraction and missing numbers.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed addition/subtraction recap activity.
lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term addition/subtraction assessment — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Practise your favourite number sentence type.

lessons.title: Museum Curator Role-Play
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain an exhibit to a visitor as if they were a museum curator.
success_criteria: I can explain what an exhibit is.
I can answer a visitor's question.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what a museum curator does.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model explaining an exhibit (toy) as a curator would.
lessons.independent_task: In pairs, children take turns being curator and visitor for their toy museum exhibits.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and topic knowledge application — evidence for ENG.SL1/HIST.1.
lessons.home_link: Be a museum curator for a toy at home and explain it to your family.

lessons.title: Reflecting on Favourite Artists Studied
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall and reflect on artists studied this half-term.
success_criteria: I can name an artist we studied.
I can say what I liked about their work.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the self-portrait artists studied in Week 1.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on what was learned about artists this half-term.
lessons.independent_task: Children draw/write about their favourite artist studied and why.
key_questions: Which artist did you enjoy learning about?
What did you like about their work?

differentiation.support: Choose from given options with reasoning support

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective recall of artist study — evidence for ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Share favourite artists with the class.
lessons.home_link: Look up more work by your favourite artist together.

lessons.title: Phonics: Half-Term Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read a range of words fluently using sounds learned this half-term.
success_criteria: I can blend and read words.
I can read a short sentence fluently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all graphemes covered this half-term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidation session covering all Phase 5 graphemes taught so far.
lessons.independent_task: Children read a range of word and sentence cards, with teacher noting fluency for half-term assessment.
resources_needed: Full range of word/sentence cards from the half-term
key_questions: Can you read this sentence fluently?
lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term phonics assessment for each child — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading over the half-term break.

lessons.title: Half-Term Recap: Shape and Measurement
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate shape and measurement skills built this half-term.
success_criteria: I can name 2D and 3D shapes.
I can compare length and mass.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap shape and measurement vocabulary.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap covering 2D/3D shapes and measurement comparison.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed shape/measurement recap activity.

differentiation.greater_depth: Extend to properties and standard units

lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term shape/measurement assessment — evidence for MATHS.GEO/MEA.
lessons.home_link: Find shapes and compare sizes of objects at home.

lessons.title: Preparing Museum Guide Booklets
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a simple guide booklet for the class toy museum.
success_criteria: I can list the exhibits in my booklet.
I can add a simple description for each.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at an example museum guide booklet.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model creating a simple booklet listing exhibits with brief descriptions.
lessons.independent_task: Children create their own mini guide booklet for the class museum.
key_questions: What will you write about each?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of topic knowledge into a written product — evidence for HIST.1/ENG.W2.
lessons.plenary: Share guide booklets with the class.
lessons.home_link: Show your museum guide booklet to your family.

lessons.title: Designing Museum Entry Tickets
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to design a ticket for the class toy museum.
success_criteria: I can design an attractive ticket.
I can include key information.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at example tickets for inspiration.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model designing a simple ticket with a title, image, and key information.
lessons.independent_task: Children design their own museum entry ticket.
key_questions: What information does your ticket need?
How will you make it attractive?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe design skill applied to a functional product — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Design a ticket for a pretend event at home.

lessons.title: Half-Term Spelling and Handwriting Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate spelling and handwriting progress made this half-term.
success_criteria: I can spell common exception words learned.
I can form my letters correctly.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap common exception words learned this half-term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap of spelling and handwriting practice.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a spelling and handwriting recap activity.

differentiation.greater_depth: Write independently with joined letters if appropriate

lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term spelling/handwriting assessment — evidence for ENG.W1.
lessons.home_link: Practise your handwriting and spellings over the break.

lessons.title: Half-Term Recap: Fractions and Multiplication/Division Basics
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate understanding of halves, quarters, and basic grouping/sharing.
success_criteria: I can find half and a quarter of a shape/quantity.
I can share/group objects equally.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap halves and quarters from Week 5.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed recap of fractions and grouping/sharing.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed fractions/grouping recap activity.
lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term fractions/early multiplication assessment — evidence for MATHS.N3/N4.
lessons.home_link: Practise finding halves and quarters at home.

lessons.title: Setting Up the Class Toy Museum
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to set up their exhibit ready for the museum opening.
success_criteria: I can arrange my exhibit neatly.
I can check my label and ticket are ready.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all elements needed for the museum (exhibits, labels, booklets, tickets).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss how to arrange an exhibit attractively and clearly.
lessons.independent_task: Children set up their toy museum exhibit, checking all elements are complete.
resources_needed: All museum materials created this topic

differentiation.greater_depth: Help arrange the whole class display

lessons.assessment_notes: Note organisational and topic synthesis skill — evidence for HIST.1.
lessons.plenary: Final walk-through before the museum opens.
lessons.home_link: Invite your family to the museum opening if possible.

lessons.title: Final Art Preparations
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to complete final preparations of their art contributions for the museum.
success_criteria: I can finish my art piece.
I can display it neatly.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art pieces still needing finishing touches.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss final checks for neat, complete display work.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete final touches on any remaining art pieces for the museum.
lessons.assessment_notes: Final art topic assessment — evidence for ART.1/ART.2 across the whole toys topic.
lessons.plenary: Recap the whole topic's art achievements.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your favourite art piece from this whole topic.

lessons.title: Museum Opening Day
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to welcome and guide visitors around the class toy museum confidently.
success_criteria: I can welcome a visitor.
I can guide them to my exhibit and explain it.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap welcoming and presenting skills practised this topic.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Final briefing on museum opening day roles and expectations.
lessons.independent_task: Children welcome and guide visitors (parents/another class) around the museum, presenting their exhibits.
resources_needed: Full museum display and all materials
key_questions: Would you like to see my exhibit?
What would you like to know about it?

differentiation.greater_depth: Lead a small group tour confidently

lessons.assessment_notes: Final half-term spoken language and topic assessment — evidence for ENG.SL1/HIST.1/HIST.2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate a successful museum opening day.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family all about museum opening day!

lessons.title: Half-Term Maths Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to celebrate and reflect on their maths progress this half-term.
success_criteria: I can say what I'm proud of in maths.
I can say what I want to get better at.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all maths topics covered this half-term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on progress and setting a goal for next half-term.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a maths celebration activity/game reflecting on the half-term.
resources_needed: Favourite maths games/resources from the half-term
key_questions: What maths are you proud of?
What would you like to improve?
lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term maths progress summary for each child — evidence across MATHS.N1/N2/N3/N4/MEA/GEO.
lessons.plenary: Big maths celebration for the half-term.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your maths progress with your family over the break.

lessons.title: Museum Reflection and Pack-Down
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on the success of the museum project.
success_criteria: I can say what went well.
I can say what I'm proud of.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the museum opening day.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on the whole project's success.
lessons.independent_task: Children write/draw a reflection on the museum project and help pack down the display, keeping favourite pieces.
key_questions: What went well with the museum?
What are you most proud of?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final reflective assessment completing the toys topic — evidence for HIST.1/HIST.2 across the whole half-term.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration of a fantastic first half-term in Year 1.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate finishing your first half-term of Year 1 with your family!

lessons.title: Half-Term Art Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to celebrate and showcase their art progress this half-term.
success_criteria: I can show my favourite art piece.
I can explain what technique I used.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art techniques learned this half-term (drawing, colour mixing, sculpture, printing, collage).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss showcasing progress made this half-term.
lessons.independent_task: Children choose and showcase their favourite art piece from the half-term to the class.

differentiation.support: Point to work and name the technique
differentiation.greater_depth: Explain the process and reasoning behind choices

lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term art progress summary for each child — evidence for ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class art celebration marking the end of Autumn 1.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your art progress with your family over the half-term break.
